example.title: Three-storey stucco apartment blocks on a palm-lined street (Wilshire Montana)
example.place: Santa Monica, Los Angeles County, CA

brief: A c. 1970 row of three-storey apartment blocks: white and cream stucco boxes with ribbon windows and balconies, carports under the ground floor, tall palms along the parkway. One photo (the nearest block). Scaled to the lot. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
